label: Three Kit
description: three.js as NodeGX nodes — a PROTOTYPE (dev-docs/parked/THREE-IN-NODES.md). Scene is a WebGL canvas and a parent; Mesh (box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, plane at X Y Z, sized, coloured, Sit On Floor, Spin, Tapped) and Light (sun, lamp, sky) go under it in the structure lane and draw nothing of their own: they tell the Scene above them what they are. A For Each under a Scene makes one mesh per row. three.js 0.158.0 is vendored beside the kit (MIT).
